_note: One requirement, one response, one expected verdict. These are the rules that decide compliance without a model, so the corpus is deliberately heavy on the ways a rule can be confidently wrong: a limit that applies to a volume, an exclusion that changes a count, a near-miss file name, a format that cannot be read from an extension.

cases.requirement: Proposals shall not exceed 40 pages.
Proposals shall not exceed 10 pages.

cases.why: Off-by-one on a limit fails a compliant proposal, which costs the same trust as passing a bad one.
cases.requirement: Proposals shall not exceed 12 pages.

cases.why: The exclusion is real and cannot close a gap this size. Refusing to decide here would be useless caution.
cases.requirement: The technical volume shall not exceed 5 pages, excluding the cover letter and resumes.

cases.why: Over by exactly the front matter the requirement excludes. Reporting a failure would be the rule's fault, not the response's.
cases.requirement: Proposals shall not exceed 3 pages, excluding the cover letter and the table of contents.

1. Approach  2. Experience  3. Price

2. Experience

cases.why: Counting a whole three-volume response against Volume I's limit fails a compliant proposal.
cases.requirement: Volume I shall not exceed 5 pages.
The executive summary shall not exceed 20 words.
pageTexts: Executive Summary. Acme Systems proposes a modern, resilient, and fully accessible 311 customer relationship management platform for the City, delivered on schedule and within the available budget envelope.

cases.requirement: The executive summary shall not exceed 5,000 words.
pageTexts: Executive Summary. Acme proposes a modern 311 platform.

cases.why: Reporting satisfied because nothing contradicted it would be an invention, and this is what proposals are rejected on.
cases.requirement: Text shall be 12-point Times New Roman, double-spaced, with 1-inch margins on 8.5 x 11 paper.
Offerors must submit a completed Standard Form 33 with Volume I.
pageTexts: Volume I — Technical Approach. Our approach follows.

cases.why: Naming a form is not attaching a signed one. The check goes as far as the evidence does and stops.
cases.requirement: Offerors must submit a completed Standard Form 33.
pageTexts: Enclosures. Standard Form 33, signed by our authorised representative.

cases.requirement: Offerors must submit a completed Standard Form 33 and Attachment J-1.
Proposals shall be submitted in Volume I — Technical, Volume II — Price, and Volume III — Past Performance.
Proposals shall be submitted in Volume I — Technical and Volume II — Price.
File names shall follow the convention RFP-2026-0041_VendorName_VolumeX.pdf.
File names shall follow the convention RFP-2026-0041_VendorName_VolumeX.pdf.
File names shall follow the convention stated by the Contracting Officer.
Each volume shall be submitted in PDF format.
Each volume shall be submitted in PDF format.

cases.why: The right extension is necessary and not sufficient, and saying so is more useful than a tick.
cases.requirement: Each volume shall be submitted as a searchable PDF.
No single file shall exceed 25 MB in size.
The certification shall be signed by an official authorised to bind the Offeror.

cases.why: A physical requirement, and one proposals are turned away at the counter for.
cases.requirement: Offerors shall deliver one original and three hard copies to the address in Block 9.
Each volume shall be spiral-bound with tab dividers between sections.
Proposals shall be submitted through PASSPort no later than the closing time.

cases.why: Reporting only the first rule is how a response passes a page count and fails on a font.
cases.requirement: Proposals shall not exceed 40 pages in 12-point Times New Roman.

cases.why: The worst outcome decides. A requirement that fails one of its parts fails.
cases.requirement: Proposals shall not exceed 2 pages in 12-point Times New Roman.

cases.why: The boundary. A rule that fired here would be judging something it cannot count.
cases.requirement: The Contractor shall maintain a Quality Control Plan throughout the period of performance.

cases.why: A rule that fires on any sentence containing the word `pages` would flood the matrix with checks nobody asked for.
cases.requirement: The Contractor shall maintain web pages describing the programme for public reference.

cases.why: The naming rule is gated on a template token, not on the word `named`. Prose says `named` constantly.
cases.requirement: Key Personnel named in Volume II shall not be replaced without the Contracting Officer's consent.

cases.why: `a single PDF named RFP-2026-0041_VendorName_VolumeX.pdf` is a naming requirement, and gating on the phrase `file names` missed it.
cases.requirement: Submit a single PDF named RFP-2026-0041_VendorName_VolumeX.pdf.
